skills.name: cad
skills.purpose: Creates and edits parametric CAD parts and assemblies as build123d Python models (via the cadgen package), exports STEP plus STL/3MF/GLB, measures geometry and opens STEP/STL/3MF/GLB files in a local CAD Viewer for visual review.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add earthtojake/text-to-cad --skill cad`. Needs Python 3.11+, `pip install -r requirements.txt` (cadgen[snapshot]) and `playwright install chromium` for snapshots. Triggers on any request to model, edit, export or inspect a 3D part.
skills.evidence: 16.6k stars and 1.7k forks; skills.sh 12.0K installs (repo 99.5K across 18 skills); MIT LICENSE inside the skill folder; repo created 22 Apr 2026 and already the largest CAD skill library.
skills.notes: Siblings in the same repo: dfam-check (printability per FDM/SLA/SLS/MJF/metal), step-parts (off-the-shelf STEP parts from the third-party catalog api.step.parts, search terms only), dxf, engineering-drawing, bambu-labs, sendcutsend (vendor quoting), urdf/srdf/sdf. The CAD Viewer fetches studio HDRI images from static.morflax.com (CDN images only, no user data sent).

skills.name: img2threejs
skills.purpose: Rebuilds the object or character in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, animation-ready Three.js model through a staged sculpting pipeline with quality gates and an AI-vision self-correction loop (reconstruction by code, not photogrammetry).
skills.how_to_use: Keep one checkout of the repo and symlink it into the skills folder, or `npx skills add img2threejs/img2threejs`. Needs Python 3.10+ (stdlib forge scripts) and agent vision plus a browser screenshot tool. Triggers on image-to-3D or 'rebuild this object in Three.js'.
skills.evidence: 17.4k stars and 1.5k forks in under three months (repo created 15 Jul 2026); Trendshift daily/weekly badges; skills.sh 1.7K installs; v2.0.0 with CI and changelog.
skills.notes: The optional vision integration downloads MediaPipe models from storage.googleapis.com and SAM2/Depth-Anything from Hugging Face (official model hosts, no user data sent). README sponsor badges (Atlas Cloud, Tripo, Hyper3D) are ads only; the core pipeline calls no paid API. Large router skill (33 KB) with grimoire/ and docs/ references.

skills.name: threejs-fundamentals
skills.purpose: Three.js scene setup: scene, cameras, WebGL renderer, Object3D hierarchy, coordinate systems and transforms, with working code patterns.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add cloudai-x/threejs-skills` (10 skills). Triggers when setting up a 3D scene, camera or renderer.
skills.evidence: 3.45k stars; skills.sh 13.3K installs (repo 113.8K across 10 skills); Smithery 1.3K installs; recommended by Snyk's 'Top Claude Skills for 3D Modeling' and clskillshub's Blender/3D write-up; mirrored verbatim in calesthio/OpenMontage.
skills.notes: README says MIT but there is no LICENSE file. Siblings: threejs-geometry, -textures, -lighting (9.9K installs), -shaders (11.9K), -postprocessing (10.2K), -interaction. threejs-animation is already ranked in motion_animation.

skills.name: threejs-loaders
skills.purpose: Three.js asset loading: GLTF/GLB with Draco and KTX2, HDR/EXR environments with PMREM, OBJ/FBX/STL/PLY, LoadingManager progress, async loading and caching.
skills.how_to_use: Install with the CloudAI-X pack; triggers when loading 3D models, textures or HDR environments.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 9.6K installs; same pack as threejs-fundamentals.
skills.notes: README says MIT, no LICENSE file. Covers the runtime side of the glTF pipeline (decoders); asset-side compression is in web-3d-asset-pipeline and gltf-transform.

skills.name: threejs-materials
skills.purpose: Three.js materials: PBR (Standard/Physical), basic, Phong, ShaderMaterial, material properties and material performance.
skills.how_to_use: Install with the CloudAI-X pack; triggers when styling meshes, setting up PBR or custom shader materials.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 11.0K installs; same pack as threejs-fundamentals.
skills.notes: README says MIT, no LICENSE file. Pair with sibling threejs-lighting (light types, shadows, IBL; 9.9K installs).

skills.name: gcode
skills.purpose: Slices STL/3MF/OBJ models into printer-ready G-code (.gcode or .gcode.3mf) with OrcaSlicer's CLI and built-in profiles for Prusa, Bambu Lab, Creality, Voron and more; never contacts a printer.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add earthtojake/text-to-cad --skill gcode`. Needs OrcaSlicer installed. Triggers when a model should be sliced for a named printer.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 7.9K installs; same fast-rising repo as cad (16.6k stars); MIT LICENSE inside the skill folder.
skills.notes: Run sibling dfam-check first for printability (overhangs, wall thickness, supports, build orientation; 2.5K installs).

skills.name: omniverse-usd-performance-tuning
skills.purpose: Top-level NVIDIA workflow for diagnosing and optimizing OpenUSD scenes: slow loading, low FPS, high memory, GPU crashes, validation failures and CAD-conversion quality, routing to setup, profiling, Usd Optimize and validation phases.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add nvidia/skills --skill omniverse-usd-performance-tuning`. Downstream phases need Omniverse Kit, Usd Optimize, USD Python and, for omniverse:// assets, NVIDIA authentication. Triggers on slow or heavy USD scenes.
skills.evidence: Official NVIDIA (signed skill with evals and BENCHMARK.md); 3.5k stars; skills.sh 2.3K installs; also shipped in openai/plugins' NVIDIA plugin.
skills.notes: Siblings: omniverse-cad-to-simready (CAD to SimReady USD, 2.3K installs), omniverse-realtime-viewer, physical-ai-neural-reconstruction (NuRec, 3D Gaussian splats). Enterprise-leaning; the only substantive OpenUSD skill found.

skills.name: openscad
skills.purpose: Creates and renders OpenSCAD models: multi-angle preview images, parameter extraction, syntax validation and STL export for 3D-printing platforms such as MakerWorld.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add mitsuhiko/agent-stuff --skill openscad`. Needs the `openscad` CLI; bundled shell tools (preview, multi-preview, export-stl, validate, extract-params). Triggers on parametric printable parts.
skills.evidence: Armin Ronacher's skill collection; 3.2k stars; skills.sh 949 installs (most-installed skill in the repo); widely mirrored (claude-skill-registry, getclaudeskills).
skills.notes: Repo licence applies (no LICENSE inside the folder). Required visual-validation step before export.

skills.name: threejs-aaa-graphics-builder
skills.purpose: Turns basic Three.js visuals into premium ones: art-direction critique, procedural model building, material and texture libraries, shader cookbook, lighting and render pipeline, LOD and instancing, render budgets and a 10-category visual scorecard.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add majidmanzarpour/threejs-game-skills --skill '*' -a claude-code -g -y`; the threejs-game-director entry skill routes to it. Triggers when screenshots look basic or the user asks for premium/AAA graphics.
skills.evidence: 2.4k stars and 241 forks since the repo was created on 14 Jun 2026; skills.sh 2.6K installs (repo 22.8K across 9 skills); adapted by mintdotgg/mint-threejs-skills.
skills.notes: Written for browser games but the graphics pass applies to any Three.js scene. References: authoring-recipes, shader-cookbook, technical-art, visual-scorecard.

skills.name: threejs-3d-generator
skills.purpose: Generates, textures, rigs, animates, stylizes and converts 3D assets for Three.js through the Tripo API: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, game-ready GLB/FBX, auto-rigging, animation retargeting, voxel and low-poly conversion.
skills.how_to_use: Install with threejs-game-skills; needs `TRIPO_API_KEY` (paid Tripo credits) and runs the bundled Python CLI `threejs_3d_asset.py`. Pair with threejs-image-generator for concept references.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 2.8K installs (top skill in the repo); same fast-rising repo as threejs-aaa-graphics-builder.
skills.notes: Calls only Tripo's official API (api.tripo3d.ai) with the user's key; paid per generation. Includes a Three.js integration reference for loading the results.

skills.name: web-3d-asset-pipeline
skills.purpose: Prepares 3D assets for the browser: Blender cleanup and export to GLB/glTF 2.0, glTF Transform optimization, mesh and texture compression, LOD and collision proxies, runtime validation; engine-agnostic (Three.js, R3F, Babylon.js, PlayCanvas).
skills.how_to_use: Part of OpenAI's Game Studio plugin; `npx skills add https://github.com/openai/plugins --skill web-3d-asset-pipeline`. Triggers on GLB/glTF shipping work, not scene code.
skills.evidence: Official OpenAI plugin (Game Studio); 7.3k stars; skills.sh 44 installs.
skills.notes: Licence declared as MIT in plugins/game-studio/.codex-plugin/plugin.json; no LICENSE file. The deeper guide (references/web-3d-asset-pipeline.md, gltf-loading-starter.md) sits at plugin level, outside the skill folder. Siblings: three-webgl-game, react-three-fiber-game.

skills.name: blender-web-pipeline
skills.purpose: Blender to web export workflows: glTF export settings, bpy batch scripts, asset optimization and compression, texture baking and automation for Three.js, R3F and Babylon.js.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add freshtechbro/claudedesignskills --skill blender-web-pipeline`. Needs Blender (bpy). Triggers on Blender glTF export, bpy automation or model compression.
skills.evidence: 974 stars; skills.sh 2.9K installs (repo 58.5K; siblings threejs-webgl 4.0K, react-three-fiber 3.1K).
skills.notes: Siblings: substance-3d-texturing, babylonjs-engine, playcanvas-engine, spline-interactive, aframe-webxr, web3d-integration-patterns.

skills.name: scenario-blender-expert
skills.purpose: Router and agent protocol for any Blender work over Python, an MCP bridge or headless `blender -b`: execution channels, Blender 5.2 API deltas, a verified headless/GUI capability matrix, and a gated expert loop with mesh audits (bx_audit.py) and review sheets (bx_review.py); routes to 12 domain skills (hard-surface, sculpting, retopology, UV/baking, texturing, geometry nodes, rigging, animation, lighting/rendering and more).
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add scenario-labs/skills --skill scenario-blender-expert` plus the scenario-blender-* domain skills. Needs Blender 5.x; works with any Blender MCP bridge or headless. No Scenario account needed for the Blender skills.
skills.evidence: Official Scenario (scenario.com) repo; 851 stars since it was created on 12 Aug 2026; skills.sh 114 installs, first seen 7 days ago (repo 19.2K); distilled from Blender Studio artists and Blender Conference talks with per-skill source lists.
skills.notes: Same repo: scenario-3d (text/image-to-3D via the Scenario MCP: Meshy, Rodin, Sparc3D; paid credits), scenario-3d-worlds (Gaussian splats), and Unity, Unreal and ZBrush expert families for engine hand-off.

skills.name: blender-director
skills.purpose: Orchestrator for Blender asset production: plans the pipeline and polycount targets, matches reference images, and routes to 90+ specialist skills (modeler, hard-surface, retopology, UV, materials, rigging, asset-optimization, export-pipeline, unity-/unreal-/godot-export, qa-review, style packs).
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add arjun988/blender-skills`. Executes in a running Blender through the BlenderMCP add-on (ahujasid) and uv. Triggers on any new Blender asset task.
skills.evidence: 263 stars since the repo was created on 5 Jul 2026; skills.sh 14.3K installs across 93 skills (rigging 234, blender-modeler 233, unreal-export 146).
skills.notes: Markdown-only skills (no bundled scripts). Depends on BlenderMCP (ahujasid/mcp-for-blender), which sends an anonymous usage record by default (prompt/code telemetry is opt-in); set DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true. Shared references live in .claude/skills/references, outside the skill folder.

skills.name: r3f-fundamentals
skills.purpose: React Three Fiber scene architecture: Canvas setup, typed JSX, hooks, the render loop and resource ownership; entry point of an 11-skill R3F set.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add enzed/r3f-skills`. Triggers on R3F scene setup; siblings cover materials, lighting, loaders, textures, shaders, postprocessing, physics (Rapier), interaction and animation.
skills.evidence: 124 stars; skills.sh 18.8K installs across 11 skills (r3f-interaction 2.9K, r3f-fundamentals 1.7K).
skills.notes: README says MIT, no LICENSE file. Recently trimmed to decision-changing guidance with fixtures (see repo maintenance doc).

skills.name: blender-image-to-3d
skills.purpose: Builds a game-ready 3D asset in Blender from reference images through gated phases (brief, camera calibration, blockout, forms, low-poly, bake, rig, export), each judged on review renders matched to the reference camera and silhouette IoU; bundled bpy scripts validate topology/UVs/weights, bake maps, export GLB/FBX with manifests and re-import.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add majidmanzarpour/blender-game-skills --skill blender-image-to-3d -g -a claude-code`. Needs Blender 5.x on the command line. Triggers whenever a reference image should become a 3D model or game asset.
skills.evidence: 126 stars within 10 days of creation (24 Sep 2026); same author as threejs-game-skills (2.4k); ships evals; skills.sh 100 installs.
skills.notes: Scripts are local bpy only (no network calls). Exports for Unity/Unreal/Godot/web via GLB or FBX.

skills.name: meshy-3d-generation
skills.purpose: Official Meshy skill: text-to-3D and image-to-3D, retexturing, remeshing, UV unwrap, auto-rigging, animation and reference images through the Meshy CLI, with rules for previews, delivery and confirming paid stages.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add meshy-dev/meshy-3d-agent --skill meshy-3d-generation --agent claude-code`. Runs `meshy` (or `npm exec meshy-cli@0.4.0`), device-code login; paid Meshy credits.
skills.evidence: Official Meshy (meshy-dev); 96 stars; skills.sh 1.9K installs (repo 4.5K); listed on mcpmarket and claudeskills.info.
skills.notes: Calls only Meshy's official API with the user's account; proposes extra paid stages before spending. Fetches the official meshy-cli from npm at run time. Sibling meshy-3d-printing (1.3K installs) prepares models for printing.

skills.name: gltf-transform
skills.purpose: Optimizes and post-processes GLB/glTF with the glTF Transform CLI: inspect stats, one-command optimize, Draco/Meshopt/quantize, WebP and resized textures, merge and simplify.
skills.how_to_use: Install from the VibeCAD plugin marketplace or copy the folder; runs `bunx @gltf-transform/cli` with no install. Triggers on 'optimize/compress this GLB'.
skills.evidence: 121 stars; the only dedicated glTF Transform skill found; part of a CAD pipeline plugin set (build123d, render-glb, model-compare).
skills.notes: Short (117 lines) command reference; KTX2/Basis texture compression is not covered and needs adding from the glTF Transform docs.

skills.name: three-best-practices
skills.purpose: Three.js performance and best-practice rules: draw-call reduction, asset compression, disposal and memory, WebGPU/TSL, shaders, lighting and Core Web Vitals, as separate rule files.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add emalorenzo/three-agent-skills`. Triggers when writing, reviewing or optimizing Three.js code.
skills.evidence: 55 stars; skills.sh 1.2K installs (plus r3f-best-practices 1.3K); featured in Snyk's 'Top Claude Skills for 3D Modeling'.
skills.notes: No LICENSE file; MIT stated in SKILL.md frontmatter and README. Sibling r3f-best-practices has 60+ rules for re-renders, useFrame, drei, Rapier and Leva.

skills.name: omniverse-gaussian-splat-to-usd
skills.purpose: Converts 3D Gaussian Splat files (.ply/.spz) into OpenUSD (ParticleField3DGaussianSplat) with orientation, up-axis, SH and scale-generation options, and troubleshoots the converter.
skills.how_to_use: Install the usd-convert-gsplat Python package from the repo (`./source/python[usd]`; OpenUSD 26.03+ preferred), then `usd-convert-gsplat -i in.ply -o out.usd`. Triggers on splat-to-USD conversion.
skills.evidence: Official NVIDIA Omniverse (repo created 23 Apr 2026); skill mirrored for Claude, Codex and Cursor in the repo.
skills.notes: GitHub reports NOASSERTION; the LICENSE file dual-licenses code Apache-2.0 and docs CC-BY-4.0. Only Gaussian-splat skill from an official source; for web splat viewing see shi3z/sparkjs-skill (unlicensed).
